title: Cross-platform edge-security MQTT messages v1
description: Top-level schema for the three message kinds published by edge-security detectors and the hub: sensecraft.detection/1, sensecraft.status/1, sensecraft.event/1. A payload must match exactly one branch, discriminated by its `schema` field.

bbox_norm.description: Normalized [center_x, center_y, width, height] in the ORIGINAL frame space (frame_norm). Senders must reverse any letterbox/pad transform before normalizing; letterboxed coordinates must never leave the device.

decode_path.description: Active video decode path. hw = platform hardware decoder (NVDEC / MPP / Hailo pipeline / CVI). sw = CPU fallback (ffmpeg/libav). A silent fallback to sw must still be reported here.

fps.description: Measured end-to-end per-stream processing rate over the reporting window, frames per second

backend.description: Inference backend identifier, e.g. tensorrt-10.3, rknn-lite2, hailort-4.x, cvimodel

fallback_active.description: true when any configured-primary path (decode or inference) is currently running on its fallback

track_id.description: Stable per-stream track ID, >= 1. 0 is reserved for detections not associated with a track

class.description: Detected class label. v1 detectors emit 'person'; the field is a string so future classes need no schema change

session_id.description: Generated once per detector process start (boot epoch ms or uuid recommended). A new value tells consumers that frame_id, track_id and event sequence counters have reset; the hub drops all per-track rule state for the device on seeing it change

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Never monotonic seconds or a float

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing per stream within one session_id

device_id.description: Stable configured device ID; must match the topic segment

stream_id.description: Stable configured source ID; required in the payload so consumers do not depend on topic parsing

coordinate_space.description: The only permitted value. Senders normalize against the original frame after reversing letterbox

w.description: Original frame width in pixels, before any model-input resize

inference_time_ms.description: Accelerator inference call only, where the API exposes it. If a backend can measure only a larger region, publish that separately as pipeline_ms and document the fact

pipeline_ms.description: Optional: capture-to-publish latency for this frame

state.description: reconnecting = source lost, retry loop active; stopped = disabled by configuration

preview_url.description: Optional: device-local HTTP endpoint returning a current single-frame JPEG for this stream; used by the hub rule-canvas as backdrop (fetched browser-side, device must allow CORS GET)

live_url.description: Optional: device-local page or stream URL for live viewing; the hub links to it and never proxies video

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at publish time. For the LWT payload this is the CONNECT time (brokers deliver LWT verbatim); consumers should use broker receipt time as the offline instant

online.description: false only in the LWT payload registered at connect

model.description: Model artifact identifier, e.g. file stem plus hash prefix

event_id.description: Globally unique within the publishing rule engine, recommended <device_id>-<stream_id>-<session_id>-<seq> so restarts cannot collide. Used as the snapshot topic segment

rule_name.description: Name of the zone or line that fired

direction.description: line_cross only. forward = crossing from the left side to the right side of the directed line start->end (see MQTT.md for the sign convention)

dwell_s.description: loitering only: seconds inside the zone when the event fired

snapshot_ref.description: Present when a snapshot exists: the snapshot topic suffix or hub storage path
